lede: Wat Lai Hin Luang accounts for 375 catalogued manuscripts, 14 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lampang (98% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Ko Kha District. Nearly all (98%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (96%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (4%). Dated witnesses run 1471–1961 CE (193 of 375 carry a date).
